note: Kraken-touched Brute (unit identity, Tidecallers; Epic; ravager entity on the hound rig, own boxes): a huge drowned beast, low in the quarters and towering at the shoulder, a mottled blue-black hide crusted with barnacle clumps and hung with kelp, a pale tusked maw with four 8 px kraken tentacles from the jaw (the signature), sea-blue girth strap, breast plate, pauldrons, brow plate and muzzle strap as fixed accent, a team-colour saddle mantle over the shoulders. Tier II bronze plate and capped tusks; tier III deep sea-blue barding and longer bronze-capped tusks. No back flag.
